_doc: arch025-n11 (PLAN N11): GPU mutation evidence for test_change.py's core-module step sets. One row per mutant x card (newest row counts): verdict (KILLED / SURVIVED / BUILD-FAIL / CAP / GATE-ERROR / NOT-RUN / DEVICE-MISMATCH) and killed_by (the release_gate GPU step that FAILed where the control PASSed). Rows are appended by `python tools/gates/test_change.py --add-kill-records kill_r9700.tsv kill_8060s.tsv --source ...` (gpumut.ps1 output); never write step sets here: test_change.core_step_sets computes them (every catalog mutant of the module on both cards, >= min_mutants KILLED per card, no survivor; set = killers + always). `--core-steps-report` prints the result. docs/dev/testing.md 'Core modules'.
